repairs.quote: Taliyah creates a massive earthen wall for 4 seconds. If she immediately Recasts, she will ride along the wall as it unravels. Moving or being immobilized will end the ride. This ability cannot be cast if Taliyah has taken damage from Champions or structures within the last 3 seconds. Once the wall is fully formed, Taliyah can Recast to destroy it early.
